evidence.head: 7fdd691431a6962f5ac71fb08e9e3e09380bae00
evidence.excerpt: Estate Service is implemented, independently buildable and container-tested. All requested acceptance checks completed locally: Java 21 build/tests, PostgreSQL startup, fresh and upgrade Flyway migrations, REST APIs, JWT authorization, atomic outbox creation, real RabbitMQ publication, Docker image and reproducible instructions. No other microservice was implemented, no central infrastructure configuration changed, no remote/commit/push/cloud deployment occurred, and Milestone 1B was not started.
